note: Calibration fixture for the offline strategy simulator. Each entry pins the strategy-arm winner family that the named censor scenario's block model is expected to yield, so a correctly built simulator scores high agreement before any generated pack ships. These are SYNTHETIC stand-ins authored from the simulator's own block models, NOT a curated archive of real field captures -- there is no real field-failure archive yet. They give the calibration harness a fixed, privacy-clean target until such an archive is curated; replace `expectedWinnerFamily` / `fieldNote` with archive-derived values as real captures land. No real network identifiers (SSID/BSSID/IMEI/IMSI/carrier/location/device IP) appear here, only synthetic scenario ids.
